from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its title and relevant classification labels."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the document")
    classification_labels: list[str] = Field(description="List of case type labels (e.g., '刑事案件', '民事案件', '管辖案件') found in or inferred from the document")
    case_keywords: list[str] = Field(description="Keywords indicating the nature of the case (e.g., '刑事', '民事', '管辖权', '受贿')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
